whyMatters.en: Huntington Park thrash band; Reign in Blood (1986, Rick Rubin) set extreme speed and short-track density for metal's outer lane.
whyMatters.zh: 亨廷顿公园 thrash；Reign in Blood（1986，Rick Rubin）为金属外道定下极端速度与短曲密度。

shortBio.en: Hanneman / King thrash; Raining Blood is the side-B detonation.
shortBio.zh: Hanneman / King 的 thrash；Raining Blood 是 B 面引爆。

body.en:
Formed 1981 in Huntington Park, California. Show No Mercy through South of Heaven document the classic Araya / Hanneman / King / Lombardo lineup—chromatic riffs, blast-adjacent tempos, dry vocal bark.

Raining Blood (1986) closes Reign in Blood's 29-minute runtime. They are the Big Four's most extreme commercial reference: less melody than Metallica, less technical display than Megadeth, more relentless tempo.
body.zh:
1981 年于加州亨廷顿公园组建。从 Show No Mercy 到 South of Heaven 记录经典 Araya / Hanneman / King / Lombardo 阵容——半音 riff、近 blast 速度、干吠人声。

Raining Blood（1986）收束 Reign in Blood 约 29 分钟片长。他们是 Big Four 里最极端的商业参照：旋律少于 Metallica，炫技少于 Megadeth，速度更不停歇。

note.en: 280 BPM blast-adjacent open—Hanneman/King chromatic twin-guitar attack.
note.zh: 280 BPM 近 blast 开场——Hanneman/King 半音双吉他攻击。

note.en: Side-B closer—tom intro then full-band detonation at 2:30.
note.zh: B 面收尾——tom intro 后 2:30 全 band 引爆。

note.en: Tempo drop after Reign—mid-paced evil as deliberate contrast.
note.zh: Reign 后降速——中速 evil 作刻意对照。

title.en: Show No Mercy to Hell Awaits
title.zh: Show No Mercy 到 Hell Awaits

body.en:
Slayer forms from local covers band; Show No Mercy (1983) and Hell Awaits (1985) push tempo past Metallica's Kill 'Em All.

Hanneman and King write chromatic dual-guitar parts; Lombardo's double-kick sets blast-adjacent speed.

Lyrics touch Satanic and war themes—controversy as marketing, not philosophy.
body.zh:
Slayer 由本地翻唱乐队起步；Show No Mercy（1983）与 Hell Awaits（1985）把速度推过 Metallica 的 Kill 'Em All。

Hanneman 与 King 写半音双吉他声部；Lombardo 双踩定近 blast 速度。

歌词涉 Satan 与战争——争议作营销，非哲学。

body.en:
Rick Rubin produces Reign in Blood (1986)—10 tracks, 29 minutes, no filler. Angel of Death opens at extreme tempo; controversial lyrics reference Josef Mengele.

Raining Blood closes side B: tom intro, riff detonation, Araya's bark over Lombardo blast beats.

Album defines thrash's outer speed limit while staying on a major label (Def Jam distribution).
body.zh:
Rick Rubin 制作 Reign in Blood（1986）——10 曲 29 分钟无 filler。Angel of Death 极端速度开场；争议歌词涉 Josef Mengele。

Raining Blood 收 B 面：tom intro、riff 引爆、Araya 吠叫叠 Lombardo blast beat。

专辑定义 thrash 外缘速度极限，仍走大厂牌（Def Jam 分销）。

body.en:
South of Heaven (1988) deliberately drops BPM—title track proves Slayer can do mid-tempo menace.

Seasons in the Abyss (1990) balances speed (War Ensemble) and groove (title track)—last classic-lineup peak.

Hanneman's death 2013 and farewell tour 2019 close the band; Reign remains the citation album.
body.zh:
South of Heaven（1988）刻意降 BPM——标题曲证明 Slayer 能玩中速威胁。

Seasons in the Abyss（1990）平衡速度（War Ensemble）与 groove（标题曲）——经典阵容最后巅峰。

Hanneman 2013 年去世与 2019 告别巡演终结乐队；Reign 仍是引用专辑。
